issues.t: Headlights shut off while driving
issues.sym: The low-beam headlights suddenly go dark at night, then may come back after restarting.
issues.why: The HID headlight system on this generation can fail intermittently. Toyota extended coverage on related parts.
issues.next: Have the headlight system diagnosed and ask a dealer about coverage history.

issues.t: Head gasket failure
issues.sym: White exhaust smoke, coolant loss, overheating, a rough-running engine, or misfire codes, often at higher mileage.
issues.why: Carbon clogging in the EGR system can raise combustion temperatures and stress the head gasket.
issues.next: Watch the coolant level. If it drops or the engine overheats, stop and have it inspected. Cleaning the EGR system during repair helps prevent a repeat.

issues.t: Clogged EGR system
issues.sym: Rough idle, misfires, hesitation, a knocking sound, or a check engine light.
issues.why: Carbon builds up in the EGR cooler, valve, and intake over time on these engines.
issues.next: Have the EGR system and intake cleaned when symptoms appear; it may help protect the head gasket.

issues.t: Inverter overheating and hybrid shutdown
issues.sym: Several warning lights at once, power loss, or the car going into failsafe mode and possibly stalling.
issues.why: Transistors in the inverter can overheat and fail. Toyota recalled these cars for a software update and extended coverage on the inverter.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the inverter recall and ask about extended coverage.

issues.t: Brake booster pump noise or failure
issues.sym: A loud buzzing or grinding noise from under the dash, brake warning lights, or a change in pedal feel.
issues.why: The brake booster accumulator can leak internally, making the pump run constantly. Toyota extended coverage on this part.
issues.next: Have the brakes checked right away if warning lights appear and ask about coverage.

issues.t: Electric water pump failure
issues.sym: Rising temperature, a hybrid system warning, or the engine shutting down to protect itself.
issues.why: The engine uses an electric coolant pump that can slow or stop, so coolant stops circulating.
issues.next: Stop driving if it overheats. Have the pump tested and replaced if needed.

issues.t: Hybrid battery wearing out
issues.sym: Lower fuel economy, the battery gauge swinging quickly, reduced power, or a hybrid system warning.
issues.why: Individual cells in the high-voltage battery lose capacity with age and mileage, creating imbalances.
issues.next: Have the battery tested. Options include replacement or reconditioning, and some cars may still have hybrid warranty coverage.

issues.t: Power steering assist can drop out from loose steering nuts (recall)
issues.sym: The steering suddenly feels heavy, mostly when turning left, and may feel loose or make a clunk.
issues.why: Nuts in the steering linkage can work loose over time, and the electric power steering then gives less help. Toyota recalled these cars to fit new nuts.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall before relying on the car. If the steering turns heavy or loose, have it looked at right away.

issues.t: Hybrid system can stall instead of going into limp mode (recall)
issues.sym: Warning lights come on and the car loses drive power and coasts to a stop. Steering and brakes still work.
issues.why: When certain hybrid parts fault, the car is meant to switch to a reduced-power backup mode. On these cars the software could shut the hybrid system down instead. Toyota recalled them for new software.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and have the software update done. If the car has already lost power this way, have a dealer inspect the hybrid parts.

issues.t: Engine wire harness can rub through and short (recall)
issues.sym: Often nothing until it fails: a burning smell, smoke from under the hood, or sudden warning lights.
issues.why: Where the engine wiring plugs into the hybrid power control unit, the wires can chafe against a cover. Worn insulation can short out and start a fire. Toyota recalled these cars to inspect the harness and add protection.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and get it done soon. If you smell burning or see smoke, stop and do not keep driving.

issues.t: Parking brake cable can come off its lever (recall)
issues.sym: The parking brake pedal sets normally but the car is not held, so it can roll if it was left out of Park.
issues.why: The parking brake cable can slip off the lever at the rear brake, so the parking brake does nothing. Toyota recalled these cars to add a clip that keeps the cable in place.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall. Until it is fixed, always put the car in Park and switch it off before getting out.

issues.t: Passenger airbag can partly inflate on its own (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no warning. The front passenger airbag could partly inflate without a crash, sometimes while the car is parked.
issues.why: A part of the passenger airbag inflator can fail and release gas into the bag. Toyota recalled affected cars to replace the airbag unit.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall and have it done before carrying a front passenger regularly.

issues.t: Rear door can open on its own from a wet door switch (recall)
issues.sym: An unlocked rear door pops open by itself, possibly while driving, often after rain or a car wash.
issues.why: The rear doors open with an electronic switch. Water can get into that switch and short it, which tells the door to open. Toyota recalled these cars, and a 2026 recall replaced the earlier fix.
issues.next: Keep the doors locked while driving, since a locked door will not open this way. Check your VIN for the recall, even if the earlier repair was done.

issues.t: Oil in the crankshaft sensor connector can stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: The car cuts out while driving or refuses to start again, often with warning lights on the dash.
issues.why: Engine oil can seep into the crankshaft position sensor plug and break the signal the computer needs to run the engine.
issues.next: Have the free recall repair done at a Toyota dealer. Stalling in traffic is dangerous, so do not put it off.

issues.t: Power steering warning light with heavy steering (recall)
issues.sym: The power steering light comes on and the wheel suddenly takes much more effort to turn.
issues.why: A poor electrical contact inside the steering torque sensor makes the system shut the assist down.
issues.next: Get it inspected under the recall. The car still steers, but parking and slow turns take real muscle.

issues.t: Steering shaft splines can wear and strip (recall)
issues.sym: The wheel feels loose or starts to turn without the front wheels following.
issues.why: The splines on the steering intermediate shaft can be too soft and wear away, so the joint can eventually let go.
issues.next: Stop driving and have the shaft inspected and replaced under the recall right away.

issues.t: Hybrid coolant pump wiring can corrode and stop the pump (recall)
issues.sym: Warning lights come on and the hybrid system drops into reduced power or quits on the road.
issues.why: A scratched coil wire in the electric coolant pump lets moisture corrode it, so the pump stops cooling the hybrid electronics.
issues.next: Have the pump replaced under the recall. Driving with the hybrid cooling down can damage expensive parts.

issues.t: Accelerator pedal can be trapped by the floor mat (recall)
issues.sym: The engine keeps revving after you lift off, or the pedal feels stuck down.
issues.why: An unsecured or stacked floor mat can catch the accelerator pedal and hold it open.
issues.next: Take the driver mat out today and get the recall fix done. If it happens, shift to neutral and brake.

issues.t: Steering intermediate shaft yoke can crack (recall)
issues.sym: Clunking or play in the steering wheel, sometimes with a notchy feel when turning.
issues.why: The sliding yoke on the intermediate shaft can crack and in the worst case separate from the shaft.
issues.next: Have it inspected under the recall before driving further; a separation means no steering at all.

issues.t: Front air bags may not inflate fully in a crash (recall)
issues.sym: Nothing is noticeable day to day; the fault only shows up in a collision.
issues.why: Some inflators were built with too little gas generating material, so the bag may not reach full size.
issues.next: Check the VIN and have the inflators replaced free under the recall.

issues.t: Brake lights may stop working from a dirty switch (recall)
issues.sym: Drivers behind you get no warning when you brake, and cruise control may not cancel.
issues.why: Oxide builds up on the brake light switch contacts until the switch no longer closes the circuit.
issues.next: Have the switch replaced under the recall promptly; being rear-ended is the real risk here.

issues.t: Load capacity label missing or wrong (recalls)
issues.sym: The sticker in the door jamb that lists how much weight the car can carry is missing or shows the wrong figure.
issues.why: Some cars were built without the required label, and on others the added-weight value printed on it is out of tolerance.
issues.next: Ask a dealer for the corrected label under the recall, and go easy on heavy loads until you know the real limit.

issues.t: Passenger air bag sensing can read the seat wrongly (recall)
issues.sym: The passenger air bag OFF light stays on with an adult in the seat, or on with nobody there.
issues.why: Fitting accessories can leave the passenger seat weight sensing system out of calibration.
issues.next: Have the seat sensing recalibrated under the recall so the bag works as designed.

issues.t: Curtain air bag inflator weld can crack (recall)
issues.sym: No symptom while driving; in a crash the inflator can break apart and throw pieces into the cabin.
issues.why: A weld in the curtain air bag inflator may be faulty and split when the bag fires.
issues.next: Check the VIN and have the inflator replaced free under the recall.

issues.t: Windshield cracks from small impacts
issues.sym: A stone chip spreads into a long crack across the glass, often at fairly low mileage.
issues.why: Owners report the factory glass is unusually easy to chip and crack; it became the subject of a class action.
issues.next: Get chips repaired early. A replacement with a camera behind it needs the driver aids recalibrated.

issues.t: Spare tire may be under-inflated from the factory (recall)
issues.sym: The temporary spare is softer than the pressure printed on the tire label.
issues.why: Some cars left the factory with the spare inflated below the specified pressure.
issues.next: Check and set the spare pressure now, and have the recall inspection done at a dealer.

issues.t: Speedometer and gauges can go blank (recall)
issues.sym: The speedometer, odometer and fuel gauge stop showing anything.
issues.why: A short inside the instrument cluster can take the display out.
issues.next: Have the cluster replaced under the recall. Driving without a speedometer is a ticket waiting to happen.

issues.t: Brake booster pump failure can switch off stability control (recall)
issues.sym: Brake and stability control warnings appear and the pedal needs more effort than usual.
issues.why: The brake booster pump can fail, which also disables stability control and brake assist.
issues.next: Have it repaired under the recall without delay; stopping distances get longer.

issues.t: Hybrid system can shut down from a software fault (recall)
issues.sym: The car loses drive power and coasts to a stop with hybrid warnings lit.
issues.why: Control software can read a fault that is not really there and shut the hybrid system down.
issues.next: Have the free software update done at a dealer before driving it far from home.

issues.t: Rearview camera image can freeze or go blank (recall)
issues.sym: The screen shows a frozen picture or nothing at all when you select reverse.
issues.why: A software error in the display system stops the live camera feed from appearing.
issues.next: Have the software updated under the recall and look over your shoulder when reversing until then.
